pages.title: New season
pages.description:
Welcome the [color=#FFC700]"Big Jackpot"[/color] season in [color=#AA3333]GRAND HORIZON RP[/color]

• [color=#FFC700]"Big Jackpot"[/color] event with a new reward track and mini-games
• Generous [color=#FFC700]gift drops[/color] across the map
• New [color=#FFC700]Black Pass[/color] season
• Updated [color=#FFC700]Event Calendar[/color]
• [color=#FFC700]"Trump"[/color] and [color=#FFC700]"Ace"[/color] cases

Jump into the party, collect chips, win prizes!

pages.title: Link social networks
pages.description: By linking your account, you will always be able to keep access to it. After linking, you will receive rewards

pages.title: Return of Illusion
pages.description:
Unique content and exciting adventures
await you for winning the [color=#FFC700]Return of the Illusion[/color] mode.

You may get the [color=#FFC700]Polar Explorer Klaus[/color] Instruction, [color=#FFC700]Holiday Stars[/color], and other valuable rewards!

pages.title: Weapon update
pages.description:
The weapon update is already in [color=#FFC700]GRAND HORIZON RP[/color]:

We have improved and added:
-Favorite weapons in a new form (Deagle -> Combat Pistol,
 AK-74M -> Assault Rifle, etc.)
-Interior and signs of all ammunition stores
-Inventory and new weapon equipment slots
-Damage indicator
-Camera control while shooting
-Reload and quick weapon switch buttons
-Weapon and ammo storage system
-Conversion of previously accumulated ammo in storage locations

pages.title: Event «Craft Festival»
pages.description:
Welcome to the [color=#FFC700]«Craft Festival»[/color]!
Take part in time and create unique accessories at the workbench: 
[color=#FFC700]• Backpack «Craft» 
• Panama «Creative» [/color]
Collect item instructions and the [color=#FFC700]special resource «Blue Steel»[/color],
whose limit refreshes daily at 5:00 MSK.

For accelerated item creation during the event: 
• Increased amount of gathered resources 
• Increased number of resource collection spots on the map 
• Increased amount of experience for successful crafting 

[color=#FFC700]The festival will end soon[/color]. Follow our updates to find out when this unique event will visit our region again. 
And right now — don't miss your benefit!

banners.name: Event «You to me, I to you!»

pages.title: Event «You to me, I to you!»
pages.description:
A [color=#FFC700]special trader[/color] has arrived in the city. 
He [color=#FFC700]buys accessories and outfits[/color] according to the rules:
• Only certain items (talk to him to see the assortment).
• The assortment is refreshed once every few days.
• Limited number of sales per day.
• The limit resets daily at 5:00 MSK.
• Play shell game - you may get more or less for your items. 

[color=#FFC700]The trader will leave soon[/color] 
Stay tuned for updates 
to find out when this mysterious guy returns to our lands again!

thumbnail.thumbnailTitle: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours!

pages.title: Story start
pages.description:
Reach [color=#FFC700]level 2[/color] to begin a special Storyline playthrough!

Its first part, [color=#FFC700]Fast Money[/color] ——
 is an exciting adventure that will help you get settled in our world.
• Meet interesting and iconic characters 
• Become part of jaw-dropping stories 
• Make your way from a newcomer to a famous and influential member of the city's elite.

Create your own story in Grand Horizon RP!

pages.title: Story start
pages.description:
Start the [color=#FFC700]special Story Line![/color]

Its first part, [color=#FFC700]Fast Money[/color], is
an exciting adventure that will help you settle into our world.
• Meet interesting and iconic characters 
• Become part of jaw-dropping stories 
• Overcome the path from a newcomer to a famous and influential representative of the city elite.

Create your own story in Grand Horizon RP!

pages.title: Story continuation
pages.description:
Only part of the path has been completed. And the most important and interesting part lies ahead!
Come back and finish the story.

pages.title: Port Logistics: Open the path to the top!
pages.description:
[color=#FFC700]Pickup Point Courier Job (lvl 5)[/color]: Become the connecting link.
• Accept and deliver cargo.
• You can get hired [color=#FFC700]at any pickup point in the city[/color].
• Your first step toward controlling the district's logistics.

 [color=#FFC700]Warehouse Worker (lvl 7)[/color]: [color=#FFC700]Nizhegorodsky Port[/color] is looking for strong hands.
• Port warehouse, dense rows of boxes, and loading work.
• Your tasks: carry cargo, fill shelves, get paid.

pages.title: We Are Giving Away Cases
pages.description:
Until March 19, every hour we raffle off [color=#FFC700]Cases[/color] and [color=#FFC700]Dust[/color]!

To participate, you need
level 5 and 20 minutes of online time during that hour.
At [color=#FFC700]PAYOUT TIME[/color], a winner will be chosen
among the players online, who will receive:
• Standard Case
• Spring Case
• Dust X250
• Dust X350
• Dust X500
In honor of the raffle, there is a [color=#FFC700]15%[/color] discount on opening the [color=#FFC700]Special Case[/color].
Good luck and enjoy the game!

pages.title: Story start
pages.description:
Start progressing through the Story Line [color=#FFC700]"Roar of Engines"[/color]'!

This is the second chapter of an exciting quest chain that will help you get to know our world better. Keep meeting characters and making useful connections, develop your skills, earn money, and take part in interesting adventures! Create your own story in [color=#FFC700]Grand Horizon RP[/color]!

pages.title: Story continuation
pages.description: Only part of the path has been completed. And ahead lies the most [color=#FFC700]important[/color] and [color=#FFC700]interesting[/color] part! Come back and finish the story.

pages.title: Storm Cup
pages.description:
Start your racer story!

Prove to the motorsport legends of [color=#FFC700]Grand Horizon RP[/color] that you can rise to the podium with the best of the best. Complete the story to the end and earn the right to join the [color=#FFC700]League[/color] of like-minded people and professionals united by the '[color=#FFC700]Roar of Engines[/color]'. Good luck!

pages.title: Storm Cup
pages.description: The beginning of your racing career has been made, but the road to the top is still long. Join the real celebration of [color=#FFC700]motorsport[/color]. Play various [color=#FFC700]racing modes[/color], climb to the top lines of the [color=#FFC700]leaderboard[/color], and claim [color=#FFC700]prizes[/color] worthy of the best of the best. Welcome, and good luck on the track!

pages.title: [color=#E0584B]GRAND HORIZON RP[/color] Birthday
pages.description:
• [color=#FFC700]Gift from the developers[/color] — from April 16 to 19
get a gift on your first login
in honor of the birthday!
The higher your level, the more valuable the reward 
• [color=#FFC700]X3 on jobs[/color] — Get triple pay until April 26
• [color=#FFC700]"AUTO CASE: 3.0"[/color] — an updated line
of cars with even more valuable rewards
• [color=#FFC700]"CASE WITH RACER TICKETS"[/color] — get tickets and
participate in thrilling races
• Two new cases with temporary cars — try rare
cars for a limited time

Celebrate the holiday with us!

pages.title: Battle for containers
pages.description:
Updated Battle for Containers!

• Bidding takes place in [color=#FFC700]Arzamas[/color] at the 30th minute of every hour, now even at night
• Two new countries: [color=#FFC700]India[/color] and [color=#FFC700]Italy[/color]
• If a total of 50 containers are bought out in each cycle, a special [color=#FFC700]Diplomatic Cargo[/color] will appear

Look for [color=#FFC700]Oleg Rubtsov[/color] in the port or in Arzamas, he will tell you the details. Don't miss the chance to earn money!
